label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Affiliate Marketing
body: Promoting other businesses' products or services and earning a commission on sales made through your unique link.
caption:
Imagine you love a certain art supply brand. You share it with your audience, and when someone buys through your special link, you get a small percentage. It's a way to earn a little extra by recommending things you genuinely use and trust. Think about products you already use and could recommend!
